notes: An arm is a set of existing runtime config keys (lib/anthropicBaybay.js reads ANTHROPIC_BAYBAY_MODEL and ANTHROPIC_BAYBAY_EFFORT, where any effort other than 'low' becomes 'medium').

The current adapter sends no `thinking` field, so no config key can turn thinking off. The nothink arm adds thinking:{type:'disabled'} to the outgoing request body inside the harness fetch wrapper (requestOverrides). This is legal on Haiku 5.5 at effort high or below and a 400 on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, so the harness only allows it for Haiku.
Opus 'as-is' is today's production setting (effort medium).
